description: Repairs r-cursor-1b/option-flags-by-type: the fixture was opened read-only, so Updatable read 0 throughout and the flag effects on updatability were not observed. For a table-type, a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over F and each Options value [omitted, 0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 128, 256, 512, 3, 12, 48, 260] (1 dbDenyWrite, 2 dbDenyRead, 4 dbReadOnly, 8 dbAppendOnly, 16 dbInconsistent, 32 dbConsistent, 128 dbFailOnError, 256 dbForwardOnly, 512 dbSeeChanges): OpenRecordset(F, type, options) on a writable Database; read Type, Updatable, Bookmarkable, EOF and RecordCount; close. Each recordset is closed before the next opens and nothing is written. The pass-through, async and exec-direct values (64, 1024, 2048) were refused by the original and are not repeated, because their purpose is ODBC. Asks which flags each type accepts, the resulting Type and Updatable on a writable open, and the refusals. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
